posts.author: sudo7777
posts.body:
i was wondering if there was a plugin that used some kind of ap mechanic but instead of being actor dependent (like say each actor has 3 ap and can attack 3 times or something) id rather the entire team have a limited tp pool and youd just freely select which actor will use ap to act instead of just selecting a skill for each and every team member
my game has a lot of potential party members currently i have to restrict the party size so you dont just have to select skills for 6-12 different actors in the same turn, id rather you just have like 3-6 ap points and can just choose who goes that turn (every skill would cost 1 ap) and would immediately trigger instead of having to queue skills for everyone
sorry if theres not anything like this already and im asking for a lot but i figured id ask in case there was

posts.body:
sudo7777 said:
and would immediately trigger instead of having to queue skills for everyone
Click to expand...
I'm a bit confused about this one. So say you have a party of 15 battlers. You have 4 AP. You choose which party members do what. You want them to execute their commands immediately, and switch to the enemy's turn after all your AP have been spent? As in, there is a player phase and an enemy phase?

posts.author: Coolie
posts.body:
Canned_Dinosaur said:
I'm a bit confused about this one. So say you have a party of 15 battlers. You have 4 AP. You choose which party members do what. You want them to execute their commands immediately, and switch to the enemy's turn after all your AP have been spent? As in, there is a player phase and an enemy phase?
Click to expand...
I believe that is exactly what is being asked for. I have tried to do this a few times, but everything always broke in the end. I'll get it eventually, as I learn more about JavaScript.
The current way the phases work, I believe, is turn start, input (entering your commands in sequence for all actor battlers), turn (player AND enemies executing their queued actions), turn end.
It's very annoying trying to have a turn start, player, enemy, turn end sequence of phases when you want the Actors to execute actions immediately after choosing them. Tracking an AP resource to determine the turn's end wouldn't be too hard to add to it, once it's working.
